svg.text: relative to unordered_dense 5.2.0, uint64_t keys, what this map itself can be asked to be

geometric mean over one octave from 1,000,000 entries; lower is better, and 1.00 is level with unordered_dense 5.2.0. Rows are sorted by the geomean of all five panels; a bar torn off at the right ran past the axis.
relative to unordered_dense 5.2.0: time for the first four panels, peak bytes per entry for the last
